statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93271
The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate
There is clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
Cardiac event monitoring is indicated to capture the rhythm during intermittent symptomatic events and guide further management
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial reason is that the service does not meet medical necessity criteria
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed insufficient prior to initiating this level of care
